keys.swarm.aura_thorn_hide_desc: When a monster hits you, a thorny vine lashes back at it.
keys.swarm.aura_thorn_hide_up: Harder lashes that also hit the monsters next to it.
keys.swarm.aura_thorn_hide_ten: Briar King: a thicket grows out from you in 8 directions.
keys.swarm.aura_taunting_roar_desc: You roar: nearby monsters are dragged in towards you, then stunned in a heap. Bosses are immune.
keys.swarm.aura_taunting_roar_up: A wider, longer stun, more often.
keys.swarm.aura_taunting_roar_ten: War Cry of the Mountain: the roar pulls and stuns the whole screen. Bosses are immune.
